text:
alex.w: Heads-up — support ticket #12345: customer seeing ~13% of audit events dropped during last peak window, plus a bunch of KMS timeout errors in the shipper logs. stack: dedicated -> shipper -> kms -> indexer.

maria.p: link to ticket? can you paste the error snippet?

alex.w: https://support.example/tickets/12345 (internal). snippet from shipper: `ERROR audit-shipper: EncryptRequest timed out after 1200ms, tenant=acme-corp, events=482`

jamal.s: That smells like per-event synchronous KMS encrypt. We should avoid per-event KMS RPCs at high QPS. Two quick mitigations: envelope encryption with cached DEKs, and async/enqueue-for-encrypt mode for low-risk events.

elaine.k: +1. Also need to check schema — some events are ~20KB which kills batching; adding `event_size_bytes` and `sensitivity_level` fields would let shipper route large or high-sensitivity events differently.

alex.w: Proposal: soft schema change — accept new fields but don't reject old events. Ship a flag `validation_mode=soft` so customers opt-in to strict validation later.

maria.p: how will customers see dropped events? support ticket shows missing audit rows. We need a customer-facing validation/telemetry path to explain root cause.

jamal.s: Quick sketch for batching heuristic: `batch_max_bytes=1_048_576` (1MB), `batch_max_events=500`, `flush_ms=250` — and if `avg_event_size > 5KB` halve batch_max_events. Use backpressure signal when queue_length > 5k or kms_latency_p95 > 200ms.

sec-bot: [ALERT] audit-shipper/kms latency p95 crossed 220ms for 3 consecutive mins. see dashboards: https://dash.ops/audit-shipper/kms

elaine.k: We should also quantify cost delta: per-KMS-call = $0.00003 (example), per-tenant-per-minute keys would be cheaper with DEK reuse. Need a simple costing calc for sales/comms.

alex.w: Implementation plan: 1) shipper: add DEK cache + async wrap pipeline (quick perf gain), 2) platform: add `pending_encryption` flag in schema, 3) validation: soft opt-in & per-tenant sampling, 4) runbook: on KMS degradation flip to `enqueue-only` mode.

maria.p: runbook bullet points? I can draft customer message templates once we have the mitigation steps.

jamal.s: Runbook excerpt (paste):
```
- Detect: kms_p95 > 150ms OR KMS error rate > 1% for 1m
- Switch shipper to: DEK_CACHE=true, ENCRYPT_MODE=async_enqueue
- Tag events: {"encryption_status":"pending"}
- Backfill: background worker re-encrypts and marks events as "encrypted"
- Fallback: if queue backlog > 500k, start sampling 1/10 non-critical tenants
- Notify: post incident note + update support with ETA
```

alex.w: Commands: `kubectl -n infra logs -f deployment/audit-shipper | grep KMSTimeout` and `curl https://metrics/api/query?metric=kms_latency_p95`

elaine.k: We also need to consider indexer cost — large batches are cheaper per-event but spike memory on indexers. Maybe cap indexer batch to 256 events and keep shipper batching separate.

maria.p: For customer comms: propose pre-emptive notice for customers > 1M events/day and offer `deferred-encrypt` toggle per tenant.

jamal.s: I'll open a PR for schema change (soft mode) and a small prototype for DEK cache (local LRU with 10k keys, rotate every 15m).

alex.w: Action items: alex.w -> collect KMS QPS & latency numbers (perf window), jamal.s -> PR for shipper DEK cache + batch heuristic, elaine.k -> costing calc and indexer memory tradeoffs, maria.p -> draft customer comms & coordinate with support. I'll raise a short all-hands note if we hit an outage.

pagerbot: Reminder: weekly sec sync tomorrow 10am — add this to agenda? :eyes:

maria.p: yes please, add runbook and customer comms as agenda items.

elaine.k: adding acceptance criteria: no more than 0.5% event loss during P95 KMS degradation and documented customer toggle in Console.

alex.w: Cool. I'll start with logs and ticket update. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
